analysis_frame.scope: Conditional exclusion of one repeated FAGVD plus the adjacent DG--- group, leaving one FAGVD. The source marks no cancellation; the 362/352 length discrepancy and exact repeat motivate the bounded comparison.

records.readable_german: Eilvese. OUI sendet ab 3X13, 12 nachts, ungedaempft an Sie mit Welle 9500. OUI empfaengt Sie Welle 4250, toenend. Vorlaufige Verkehrszeiten: OUI sendet 12 nachts bis 0100, 0330 bis 0345, 0530 bis 0600.

headers: D) NKJ (UKS) v LP (3 p.m., November 3rd)
limits: The 362-slot literal source and advertised 352-slot length remain separate. The full native decode is preserved.
The primary model excludes ten printed slots: seven accepted coordinates and three dashes. The source shows a repetition but no cancellation; the exclusion is a conditional hypothesis.

All 353 contiguous ten-slot exclusions and all 2556 pairs of complete five-slot groups are priced against a fixed full edited candidate. The complete minimum sets are retained, including alternatives that require additional source-mask fills.
Eight contiguous deletion starts (175 through 182) yield the same complete no-fill raw stream. Two whole-group choices also yield that same stream. No unique historical deletion site is inferred.
The ordinary-word proposal changes UNGEDAENPFT to UNGEDAEMPFT and BIX to BIS at three observed-coordinate substitutions. VORLAUFIGE and all numerical labels remain literal.

3X13 is not normalized into a date. Wavelength and time labels are literal outputs under the published square; the edition does not independently authenticate their historical numerical assignments or attach unstated units or time zones.
The header announces two parts but only this first part is recovered here. A different nearby telegram is not silently supplied as its continuation.
Published period-key recovery and earlier repository work retain their credit. This is a conditional source restoration, not a first decipherment.
